from.place: the proof's final clause: the open subschemes in question are quasi-compact, so the open immersion is of finite type

title: A quasi-compact open immersion is of finite type
statement: Let $j:U\to Y$ be a quasi-compact open immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-open-immersion]. Then $j$ is of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism].

source.place: Stacks Project, Section 29.15, Tags 01T0 and 01T2: an open immersion is locally of finite type, and finite type is locally of finite type plus quasi-compact
